notes: Each case lays out one place (story id, place id, the place's footprint or null to roll one, `below`, and parameter picks or null) with Interior.lay_out! and reads back what it built. rooms are in creation order (index 0 is the entry); danger is what the room was written with (Danger.for_a_new_room, then the building's own roll when there are picks). edges are [from, to, distance, travel_method] by room index in the order they were written, one per direction. The story starts at 2026-01-01 00:00 UTC and holds only this place.
